run_linear_eval_cell_dino: run the DINOv2 linear evaluation script for cell DINO classification with argparse CLI
train_linear_classifiers: train linear classifiers on frozen DINOv2 features with AdamW optimizer and grid search over learning rates
eval_linear_with_model: evaluate a DINOv2 model with linear probing on cell biology datasets including leave-one-out strategy
create_linear_input: create concatenated feature input from intermediate transformer blocks with optional average pooling and bag of channels
setup_linear_classifiers: setup multiple linear classifiers with grid search over learning rates and weight decays for DDP training
